title: Vader overturns New Japan’s hierarchy
summary: Big Van Vader arrives as a physically overwhelming threat and defeats Inoki immediately. His rise culminates in winning the heavyweight championship at New Japan’s first Tokyo Dome event.

chapters.title: Vader defeats Inoki on arrival
chapters.result: Vader defeats Inoki after Inoki has already wrestled Choshu.
chapters.context: The sudden loss establishes the newcomer as a monster opponent, while the earlier match is important context for the upset.

chapters.title: Vader wins the Dome tournament
chapters.result: Vader defeats Hashimoto in the final for the vacant IWGP title.
chapters.context: Wins over Chono and Fujinami precede the final, completing his rise from disruptive newcomer to heavyweight champion.
